conditions: Wisp Prime is vaulted: no Wisp relics currently drop from missions or appear in the relic console.
Aya is untradeable, but has no cap and remains after Prime Resurgence rotations end.
Complete bounty bonus objectives for a second final-stage reward roll, which can be Aya.
bonuses: Deimos tier-4 and tier-5 bounties are the community-preferred active Aya route; Hepit, Void Capture is a low-attention fallback.
Avoid spending Steel Essence or syndicate standing on relic packs specifically for Aya; active bounties are generally faster.

disclosures.title: the calendar is the gate
disclosures.body: Varzia changes Prime Resurgence stock every 28 days at 18:00 UTC. Verify her live shop when Wisp returns: the exact relic names can change between rotations. Until then, trade for the set or bank Aya and Void Traces.

conditions: All listed relics are vaulted. Confirm the actual relic IDs in Varzia's shop before spending Aya; she may stock newly issued relics instead.
Buy the Chassis relic with an Uncommon reward when it is offered: Neo H4 is dramatically cheaper than chasing it as a Rare.
Relics are tradeable and never expire, so buy enough during the rotation to finish later.
bonuses: Varzia is also available from the Orbiter Relic Segment or Prime Resurgence Market tab.
A friend may buy tradeable relics with their Aya.

rows.label: Wisp Prime Chassis
rows.note: Neo H4, Uncommon: 20% per Radiant relic

conditions: Refine Blueprint relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces). Four matching Radiant relics give a 34.39% chance that someone opens the Rare reward.
Use Radiant for the Uncommon Neuroptics and, unless Neo H4 is available, the Rare Chassis. Run Systems Intact: refining lowers a Common reward's chance.
Get 10 Reactant before extraction. A relic is not consumed below 10 Reactant, but it produces no reward.
bonuses: Use the Vaulted Relic Community Discord or radshare.xyz for vaulted radshares; regular Recruitment can be thin.
When another player picks the same wanted reward, choose their copy: you keep the part and they receive extra Void Traces.
Let enemies corrupt before killing them, and do not start extraction while a teammate is at 9/10 Reactant.

disclosures.title: one relic gives one reward
disclosures.body: A relic may contain multiple Wisp parts, but each crack grants only one selected reward. Continue the matching radshare until every part is secured.

conditions: Component blueprints come only from relics; the Prime frame blueprint is not a Market purchase.
Components build in parallel. Keep a free Warframe slot for the final claim.
